content.name: Aura of Courage
entries: Starting at 10th level, you and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you can't be {@condition frightened} while you are conscious.
At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

content.name: Aura of Courage
entries: You and your allies have {@variantrule Immunity|SRD52} to the {@condition Frightened|SRD52} condition while in your Aura of Protection. If a {@condition Frightened|SRD52} ally enters the aura, that condition has no effect on that ally while there.
